source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.14 with Example 5.5 (PDF 113).

blocks.text: Dhund (fog) ke pani ke qatre jaisa ek qatra lein jo seedha neeche gir raha hai. Qatre par hawa ka drag speed ke saath barhta hai. Shuru mein gravity ki force ghalib hoti hai aur qatre ko tezi se neeche kheenchti hai, is liye qatre ki speed tezi se barhti hai (acceleration). Lekin speed barhne ke saath qatre par oopar ki taraf drag force bhi barhti jati hai. Qatre par net (kul) force:

blocks.alt: Girta hua pani ka qatra. Us ke markaz se surkh teer neeche wazan w = mg aur sabz teer oopar hawa ka drag F = 6 pi eta r v dikhata hai. Baen taraf teer v qatre ki velocity neeche dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Girte qatre par forces: wazan neeche, drag oopar (hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Shuru mein drag chhota hai aur qatra tez hota jata hai. Speed barhne se drag F = 6πηrv barhta hai, yahan tak ke F weight mg ke barabar ho jaye; tab net force zero aur qatra terminal velocity se girta hai.

Speed barhti rehti hai to drag force aakhir kaar weight ke barabar ho jati hai. Jab drag force weight ke barabar ho jaye to qatre par net force zero ho jati hai, aur qatra ek constant speed se girta hai. Is speed ko terminal velocity (aakhri, mustaqil speed) kehte hain.
Terminal velocity vₜ nikalne ke liye drag force ke liye Stokes' law lete hain aur use qatre ke weight ke barabar rakhte hain:
Qatre ka mass ρV hai, jahan V = (4/3)πr³ sphere ka volume hai, yani m = (4/3)πr³ρ.
Ise Eq. (5.30) mein rakhein: vₜ = (4/3)πr³ρg / (6πηr); π aur ek r kat jate hain aur 4/(3 × 6) = 2/9 bachta hai:

blocks.title: Example 5.5
blocks.problem: 0.010 cm radius ka pani ka nanha qatra ek oonchi imarat se hawa mein neeche aata hai. Us ki terminal velocity nikalein. Hawa ke liye η = 19 × 10⁻⁶ kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹ aur pani ki density ρ = 1000 kg m⁻³ hai.

blocks.caption: Terminal velocity tak pohanchna
rows: drag speed ke saath barhta hai; net force = weight − drag

blocks.prompt: Hawa mein girte 0.5 mm radius ke barish ke qatre ki terminal velocity Stokes' law (Eq. 5.31) se nikalein, aur batayein ke vₜ radius ke square (r²) ke proportional kyun hai.
blocks.explanation: vₜ = 2gr²ρ/(9η) = 2 × 9.8 × (5 × 10⁻⁴)² × 1000 / (9 × 19 × 10⁻⁶) = 4.9 × 10⁻³ / 1.71 × 10⁻⁴ ≈ 28.7 m s⁻¹. (Itne bare qatre par bahao aahista nahi rehta, is liye asal speed is se kafi kam hoti hai; Stokes' law sirf aahista chalte chhote spheres ke liye theek hai.) Weight r³ ke saath barhta hai jab ke Stokes drag r ke saath; dono barabar karne se vₜ r³/r = r² ke proportional aata hai.

items: Girta qatra: net force = weight − drag; drag speed ke saath barhta hai jab tak weight ke barabar na ho; phir speed constant: terminal velocity.
Example 5.5: r = 0.010 cm ke liye vₜ ≈ 1.1 m s⁻¹.
